title: P2 exit: migration instruction, allowlists and full qualification
summary: The P2 exit criterion holds on one commit: every supported change of P2 has a line in the AI-agent migration instruction, all allowlists hold only owner-P3 entries, I4/I6/I7/I8/I10/I11/I14/I20 are green, and the full matrix passes on SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL and MariaDB including engine suites.
why: P2#validation V1 and P2#exit: P3 may relocate files only if scope, audit and generators already run through the final contracts. Collecting the proof in one item catches drift between items (an entry fixed in one item and reintroduced in another).

include: Compare the migration instruction with knowledge/upgrade-map (P2 rows) and the type-map P2 rows whose `was` is published; add missing lines; keep it short (one bullet per change)
tests/Arch/MigrationGuideTest.php: every type-map row with phase containing P2, action rename/move/retire/split and published `was` has its old FQCN in the docs/upgrade.md 0.7→1.0 section
Verify i2/i3/i4/i5/i7/InactiveCost lists: only owner-P3 entries; i9 findings empty; invariants.json statuses for I4, I6, I7, I8, I11, I14, I20 updated to their P2 checks

Independent consumer fixture through the same slots (I8): a test plugin outside `AzGuard\` contributes a before hook, restriction, pipe, participant and scope evaluator and is subject to the same validation as built-in modules (tests/Fixtures/Modules or existing contract worlds)
Fix anything the full run reveals inside P2 scope; record anything outside as a plan log entry

reads.why: Rules every P2 item follows (reference wins, no shims, D17 placement, attributes, snapshots, migration lines)
Report-mode allowlist protocol and which entries this item removes
Exact validation commands and driver environment
Seed list of supported symbol changes (input for the instruction)
Seed list of config/CLI changes (P2 rows)
Condition 4 (extension semantics) proven by the independent consumer fixture

rules: No allowlist entry with owner P2 survives; an entry may not be re-labelled P3 unless its type-map row assigns the fix to P3.
Acceptance runs on one commit; evidence for every V# is stored per the plan-run procedure.

validation.cmd: php -r 'foreach (glob("tests/Arch/Allowlists/*.json") as $f) foreach (json_decode(file_get_contents($f),true) as $e) if (($e["owner_phase"]??"")!=="P3") exit(1); foreach (json_decode(file_get_contents("tests/Fixtures/InactiveCost/allowlist.json"),true) as $e) if (($e["owner_phase"]??"")!=="P3") exit(1);'
php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Parity tests/Feature/InactiveCost tests/Regression/Baseline070 --fail-on-skipped
composer analyse && composer lint:check && composer refactor:check && composer api:check
export PGSQL_PORT=55432 MYSQL_PORT=53306 && composer test:pgsql && composer test:mysql && composer test:mariadb
export PGSQL_PORT=55432 MYSQL_PORT=53306 && composer test:engines:pgsql && composer test:engines:mysql && composer test:engines:mariadb
